name: small-committee
description: Seven members in key order: an entity of two licensed members (30 + 10), licensed members of 25, 20 and 15, an uncertified member of 10 and a licensed member of weight 0; cap 25%, u_max 25%, L_max 25%. Members 3, 0 and 2 stay silent as leaders in turn, members 3 and 0 twice: convictions, the 50% exclusion cap (convictions without room discarded, then a later one excluded), releases, recovery and the budget. Member 4 has an NR self-contradiction twice in one sign window, then again (L1, then L2 by repeat); member 5 a double vote (L2), so that L_max queues member 4 until member 5 is released. Round 25 times out without an accusation, so the first terminal block is later.

name: default-caps
description: Twenty-three members in key order with the default caps (cap 5%, u_max 25%, L_max 10%): eighteen licensed members of their own, one licensed entity of two members, two uncertified members whose share is held to n_U * cap = 10%, and an uncertified member of weight 0. Member 0 stays silent and is convicted; member 5 fails one lead in three and is not. Members 3, 4 and 6 double-vote in one epoch: their correlated share is above the cap, so L3, and L_max queues the third. Member 10 has an NR self-contradiction (L1).
